title: Friends Share Toys
yt_description:
Learn to share toys with friends and have fun playing together. This song teaches social skills and friendship values. Encourage your child to share and care for others.

🎵 Friends Share Toys

Pip is here
With a toy to share

Lulu wants to play
With the ball today

Share, share, it's fun to share
With our friends, we show we care

Share, share, it's fun to share
With our friends, we show we care

Friends share toys
And have fun joys

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #sharing #toys #friends
